children: 3Q26 adjusted EBITDA was €1,162M versus €365M in 3Q25, and adjusted net income was €808M versus €186M. The board doubled the interim dividend to €0.40 per share from €0.20.
Sharp year-over-year increase; performance was driven mainly by higher refining margins, crude supply optimisation and export netbacks.
Profitability rose substantially year over year, alongside the EBITDA increase.
Higher shareholder distribution reflects strong 9M performance; the company said it expects to announce the full-year dividend in February 2027.
Cash generation helped reduce net debt by €0.6B from year-end 2025 to €1.5B.
The margin was described as historically high; the release attributes stronger results partly to constrained product supply.

This is a quarterly results release showing a strong 3Q supported by unusually high refining margins and supply disruptions. Investors will look for the next quarter's margins and cash generation, and the announced full-year dividend in February 2027.
